notes: Shortcuts now show the real icon of the app they open, instead of its initial and its name. The icons were already being fetched; the card was drawing the fallback over them.
Volume, Brightness and Microphone now show a meter. The line under them used to read OFF on its own - the value of a field whose name had been dropped, which said the opposite of what it meant.
The calendar reaches the bottom of its card.
Fixed a regression from the previous release: centring the power icons in their card pushed that card 60px out of line with its neighbours.
